text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My own chapter in the history of Team
Sirius began with only Mejiro
McQueen at
my side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her incredible ability to capture hearts
and minds has been the crux
of our team's
growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But with every person she inspired, the
weight of their expectations
grew heavier.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This reminds me—something similar
happened before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just when I was about to break down, you
came running after me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I suppose what happens next will be no
different as well.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's all I can do. There is just so much I
have yet to figure out as a
trainer...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's all I can do. There is just so much I
have yet to figure out as a
trainer...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even realize that my hopes for
you
were turning into obstacles
in your path.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even realize that my hopes for
you
were turning into obstacles
in your path.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But it's not just that we expect a lot
from
you... You've inspired
everyone on Team
Sirius.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But it's not just that we expect a lot
from
you... You've inspired
everyone on Team
Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How can you find inspiration in someone
who can't even run according
to race
rules?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Someone who has caused so much
nuisance toward my fellow racers,
and
even my trainer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Because we have faith in you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Because we have faith in you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many mistakes trip you up
along the way...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many mistakes trip you up
along the way...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You'll keep going, and we'll keep
cheering.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You'll keep going, and we'll keep
cheering.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: We believe in you, and that's not changing just because of a bad race or two!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: We believe in you, and that's not changing just because of a bad race or two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Remember what they said about Oguri?
That she couldn't win
anymore?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But everyone on the team supported Oguri
right until the very end.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But everyone on the team supported Oguri
right until the very end.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No matter the results, she went into every
race determined to make us
proud—and
that's what made her our ace.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No matter the results, she went into every
race determined to make us
proud—and
that's what made her our ace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An "ace"... Someone the team takes pride
in, win or lose...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Have I... really become such an
Umamusume in the eyes of others?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Am I really their ace? Am I inspiring
everyone to chase their dreams?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hic... Ah... Waaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen breaks into tears,
releasing all of the pressure that
had built
up within her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um... I've returned.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What would Grandmother think if she
knew that one of her precious
ladies was
spending her time out late at night?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We were worried about you, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not only did I fail to win today's race,
but I
also caused you all to
worry so much. I'm
not sure what to say...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey now, that's so not the point! No more gloomy words from you, missy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: H-hey! What on—what are you doing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've got somethin' to say, right? People
hear you better when you
speak from on
high, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go back out there and run, my
head held high!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I might lose again, and I might even cry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But despite that,
I will shoulder your hopes
and keep running—as your
team's ace!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You go, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm always,
always going to believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Let's go, ace!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You know, that was pretty cool, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep running together for as long as
we can!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you figured out how to turn
those expectations into
strength,
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
G-geez, I've said everything on my mind.
You can let me down now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The laughs coming from the training staff
room continue to echo
through the halls
late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One month later...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aahhh... I'm getting all nervous!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, why does it feel like this when it's
not even our race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's because you see some of your own
hopes and dreams in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And that is exactly what is going to
propel
me forward today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Get out there and snatch that Grand Prix
Umamusume title,
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll be back soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One year ago, Oguri Cap made a miracle
happen at the Arima Kinen.
And today, we
stand ready to make our mark at the very
same race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One year ago, Oguri Cap made a miracle
happen at the Arima Kinen.
And today, we
stand ready to make our mark at the very
same race.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the year's final major bout,
the Arima Kinen! The race is
about to start!
